However, she suddenly remembers that was a secret and realizes will be mad at her. She was not supposed to reveal 's love of to anyone.

If speaks to with an in his , she will ask for it. Once Link gives one to her, she decides that the two of them could get along. Hearing that is a traveler, reveals that she has a request for him. is a fan of , She thinks it is something can not talk about with the people she is closest to. asks to talk to about the , so she can get it for her birthday. This begins the "" .

During the , will have another secret to share with Link. While reading a book, saw pictures of a , a , and an , but thought their eyes were creepy and got mad when showed them to her. Once again, she realizes that was a secret she was not supposed to share. When she grows up, wants to travel and meet dragonflies.

When finds out that wants to see dragonflies, she is shocked. She reasons that kept her love of them to herself since despises them so much. For 's birthday, asks to obtain the three dragonflies. Since it is a surprise, she asks to say nothing to .
